rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for going from one side of something to the other.

example.english: We need to cross the road now.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ji4 gaa1 jiu3 gwo3 maa5 lou6

rows.note: Use this for the wooden execution cross and for a Christian cross used as a religious symbol or pendant.

example.english: A cross is common inside a church.
example.traditional: 十字架喺教堂入面好常見。
example.jyutping: sap6 zi6 gaa3 hai2 gaau3 tong4 jap6 min6 hou2 soeng4 gin3

rows.note: Use this for an X-shaped mark, especially one put beside a wrong answer.

example.english: The teacher put a cross beside the question I got wrong.
example.traditional: 老師喺我答錯嗰題旁邊寫咗個叉號。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 hai2 ngo5 daap3 co3 go2 tai4 pong4 bin1 se2 zo2 go3 caa1 hou6

rows.note: Use this for a crossroads where roads meet and continue in different directions.

example.english: Once you cross this crossroads, you'll be there.
example.traditional: 過咗呢個十字路口就到喇。
example.jyutping: gwo3 zo2 ni1 go3 sap6 zi6 lou6 hau2 zau6 dou3 laa3

rows.note: Use this when marking a box or item with an X.

example.jyutping: cing2 hai2 ni1 gaak3 daa2 gaau1 caa1

rows.traditional: 喺 A 上面畫一條線
rows.jyutping: hai2 A soeng6 min6 waa2 jat1 tiu4 sin3
rows.note: Use this construction when drawing a line across a letter or another written item.

example.english: You can cross the letter with a line.
example.traditional: 你可以喺個字上面畫一條線。
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 hai2 go3 zi6 soeng6 min6 waa2 jat1 tiu4 sin3

rows.note: Use this football term for a pass from the side of the pitch toward the goal area.

example.english: He sent in a cross from the right wing, and the striker headed it in.
example.traditional: 佢喺右路傳中，前鋒頂入咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 jau6 lou6 cyun4 zung1 cin4 fung1 deng2 jap6 zo2

rows.note: Use this for placing body parts or objects across each other, such as crossing your arms.

example.english: I cross my arms when I sit down.
example.jyutping: ngo5 co5 dai1 zau6 wui5 gaau1 caa1 soeng1 sau2
